acceptance.given: During validator evaluation, the validator implementation and source metadata are available for direct inspection.

oracle.expected: Independent evidence identifies the validator source, verifies its content or identity, and reports source verification success without relying on another obligation.
forbidden: Validator source verification is omitted or inferred solely from another verification.
oracle.observable: A validator-source artifact records the inspected repository source path, source identity/content check, and independent pass result.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Remove or bypass validator-source inspection while leaving other validator checks enabled.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Add or preserve an independent validator-source inspection that records source identity/content verification and does not derive its result from another obligation check.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Keep validator interfaces and existing source bytes compatible; rollback only the independent source-check change.

slice_hint.state_transition: unverified validator source -> independently verified validator source
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The validator-source artifact names the inspected source and independently reports pass; omission or inference from another check fails.

acceptance.given: Repair work is executed against a repository containing existing tracked bytes.

oracle.expected: A byte-level before/after comparison reports equality for every existing byte, while any newly authored file is separately classified as new.
oracle.observable: The comparison result includes baseline and post-repair byte manifests and a zero-difference result for existing files.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Modify one byte in an existing tracked file before running the repair comparison.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Perform a byte-level baseline/post-repair comparison and classify only explicitly planned new files as additions; reject any delta in pre-existing files.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve existing file contents and manifest format; rollback only comparison logic changes.

slice_hint.state_transition: existing repository bytes present -> verified unchanged after repair
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The byte comparison reports no differences for all pre-existing files; any existing-file delta is a hard failure.

acceptance.given: The evaluation seed record contains each of the three named evaluation seed occurrences exactly once.

oracle.expected: For every named seed occurrence, the record contains either a concrete counterexample or an explicit absence marker, together with provenance and applicability fields.
forbidden: A named evaluation seed occurrence contains neither a counterexample nor an explicit absence.
oracle.observable: Seed-manifest validation emits one outcome per named seed and each outcome is counterexample-present or explicit-absence.

acceptance.then: Every named evaluation seed occurrence has a counterexample or an explicit absence.
acceptance.when: When the evaluation seed occurrence is recorded.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Delete both the counterexample and explicit-absence fields for one named seed while retaining the occurrence entry.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Validate each of the three named seed occurrences exactly once and require a mutually exclusive counterexample or explicit-absence outcome with provenance and applicability.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Maintain existing seed manifest fields and accept previously valid records; rollback only strengthened outcome validation.

slice_hint.state_transition: seed occurrence outcome unspecified -> each occurrence classified as counterexample or explicit absence
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Validation passes only when all three named occurrences have exactly one allowed outcome; any missing outcome fails.

acceptance.given: The compiled obligation graph contains Atomic Obligation nodes and runtime-evidence nodes with declared coverage edges.

oracle.expected: Exact-cover validation reports a one-to-one bidirectional relationship for every Atomic Obligation-to-runtime-evidence edge: every obligation has reverse runtime-evidence coverage and every runtime-evidence node maps back to a covered obligation.
forbidden: An Atomic Obligation is covered by runtime evidence without reverse coverage.
A runtime-evidence node is linked without corresponding Atomic Obligation coverage.
oracle.observable: The exact-cover validator output enumerates forward and reverse coverage for every Atomic Obligation/runtime-evidence pair and reports no orphan nodes.

acceptance.then: Every Atomic Obligation and its runtime-evidence coverage are mutually and exactly covered.
acceptance.when: When the obligation graph is compiled or exact-cover validation is run.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Remove the reverse edge from one runtime-evidence node while retaining its forward Atomic Obligation edge.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Compile and validate forward and reverse runtime-evidence coverage edges for every Atomic Obligation, rejecting missing reverse links and orphan runtime-evidence nodes.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve existing exact-cover graph schema and validator CLI; rollback only runtime-evidence edge checks.

slice_hint.state_transition: runtime-evidence coverage relation unverified -> bidirectionally exact-covered relation
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Exact-cover output contains forward and reverse entries for every Atomic Obligation/runtime-evidence pair and zero orphan diagnostics.
